{

 "content": "from collections import Counter, deque


def transform(grid):
    """Fill outlined square frames: odd side -> 7, even side -> 2."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if (0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and
                            grid[yy][xx] != bg and (yy, xx) not in seen):
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        q.append((yy, xx))
            r0 = min(y for y, _ in cells)
            r1 = max(y for y, _ in cells)
            c0 = min(x for _, x in cells)
            c1 = max(x for _, x in cells)
            # Only fill a single-color, one-cell-thick square outline.
            side_h, side_w = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
            if side_h != side_w or side_h < 3 or any(grid[y][x] != color for y, x in cells):
                continue
            frame = set(cells)
            perimeter = ({(r0, x) for x in range(c0, c1+1)} |
                         {(r1, x) for x in range(c0, c1+1)} |
                         {(y, c0) for y in range(r0, r1+1)} |
                         {(y, c1) for y in range(r0, r1+1)})
            if frame != perimeter:
                continue
            fill = 7 if side_h % 2 else 2
            for y in range(r0+1, r1):
                for x in range(c0+1, c1):
                    out[y][x] = fill
    return out
"

def board(h,w,bg,frames):
